purpose: Teach: 爐/駝/實/濤/鵬/鮖/鵝/蛎

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、産業医学の爐、つまり溶鉱炉作業者の健康管理を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, with our medical team, we manage the health and safety of industrial furnace workers—blast furnace operators especially.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady rhythm. Clinical but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'furnace workers' to ground the specific case. Even pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、駝、つまり駱駝、ラクダ由来のMERS感染症を医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we're also monitoring for MERS infections originating from camels—cases transmitted through that zoonotic pathway.
lines.style: Same professional steadiness. Slight pause before 'camels' to acknowledge the specificity. Matter-of-fact delivery. No dramatization of the disease risk.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「實」、つまり実験データの原典確認を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our team verifies the original data sources for all experimental findings—checking the primary documentation carefully.
lines.style: Methodical, deliberate pace on 'original data sources.' Clinical attention to detail. Voice carries quiet insistence on rigor. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、津波、つまり怒濤の被災者ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, when disaster strikes—tsunamis, flooding—our medical team coordinates care for the affected communities.
lines.style: Grounded, serious tone. Slight weight on 'disaster' and 'affected communities.' Steady, compassionate. The kind of calm that comes from experience with emergencies.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チームで鵬の様な大きな視野を持って診療します
lines.en: Ren, we approach each patient with a broad perspective—like the mythical roc, seeing the full landscape of their health.
lines.style: Slightly more metaphorical here. Softer opening. Warm but still clinical. 'Broad perspective' lands with quiet conviction. Pacing widens slightly on the metaphor.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、栄養指導で鮖、つまりカジカ等の魚類を医療チームで紹介します
lines.en: Ren, in nutritional counseling, we recommend certain fish—like kajika—that support overall wellness within our integrated care approach.
lines.style: Practical, concrete. Warm when naming the fish. Clinical frame but with genuine care underneath. No condescension. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鵝、つまりガチョウ由来の鳥インフルを医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we monitor for avian influenza from waterfowl—geese particularly—tracking transmission patterns across the medical team's oversight.
lines.style: Steady, alert without alarm. Slight precision on 'geese particularly.' Even pacing. The tone of someone who watches for these things as part of routine excellence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「蛎」、つまり牡蠣食中毒の対応を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, oyster-related food poisoning requires careful protocol management—our team coordinates response with that kind of detailed attention.
lines.style: Measured, serious. Closes with understated finality. Slight exhale on the final phrase. Professional confidence that borders on reassuring. The period lands softly.
